PROP-5a6a79d5-inv-037.text: Seen-block cache must not skip sender recovery on blocks with known hash but new content.
PROP-5a6a79d5-inv-037.assertion: forall block, seen: block.hash in seen => recover_sender(block.tx) must still run if block.body differs

locations.note: Block processor must recover senders for all transactions even if block hash is seen; search for caching logic that may bypass sender recovery
